atOrComparison.observation: Both LF measurements use the post-dense optimized kernel. Main instruction-stream differences are addition/overflow branch versus OR at two event decode sites and ordering of constant initialization before the word loop; slow-path stack slots also differ. This does not establish instruction alignment, branch prediction, or register pressure as the cause.
